about.title: Web Developer And Telegram bot Developer
about.body:
I’m Dagim Desalegn, a Junior Full-Stack Developer from Ethiopia. I enjoy building useful digital products that are clear, reliable, and actually solve real problems.

I graduated in Computer Science from Jimma University and have worked on projects like Erdataye, an emergency service app for rapid ambulance dispatch and live tracking, and ABJ Tutorial, an educational platform that has helped thousands of students. I’ve also completed certifications in web development, programming fundamentals, and AI.

I care about thoughtful interfaces, clean code, and building things that make life a little easier for people.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Software Developer, the Employee’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to, designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software applications and systems; developing and maintaining backend systems, databases, APIs, and other technical solutions; maintaining and improving the Company’s websites, applications, and digital platforms; troubleshooting, debugging, and resolving technical and software-related issues; participating in software planning, system design, and implementation; ensuring the security, performance, and reliability of Company systems; managing and maintaining technical documentation and software projects; collaborating with management and other employees when required; and performing other reasonable duties related to the position as assigned by the Company.
